title: The hollow gleaner hazard in the Hearthlands' fields is never named or flagged as a roaming/randomized threat — the same tile (Tithing's Edge) was clear on my first pass through and had a gleaner waiting on the very next pass, with no in-fiction cue that field tiles behave this way.
